title: B1 Milestone 1: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Primer Hito del Nivel B1. Tu inglés corporativo es cada vez más profesional.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 1 a 4 del nivel B1: 
- Tiempos Futuros (Will vs Going to vs Present Continuous). 
- Servicio al Cliente (Apologize, complain, handle, refund).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 1 to 4 of the B1 level: Future tenses and Customer Service vocabulary.

parts.visual:
- Present Perfect (I have worked, She has finished, Have you ever...?). 
- Negociaciones Básicas (Make an offer, reject, compromise, win-win). 
¡Buena suerte!
parts.audio: We will also review the Present Perfect tense and Basic Negotiations. Good luck!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 1-4).

questions.question: The phone is ringing. I ____ answer it. (Decisión espontánea).
We ____ a new manager next month. That is our plan. (Plan/Intención).
I ____ to London tomorrow. The tickets are booked. (Confirmado).
We sincerely ____ for the delay. (Nos disculpamos).
The client called to ____ about the broken product. (Quejarse).
If you are not happy, we will give you a full ____. (Reembolso).
I ____ worked in marketing for five years. (He trabajado).
She ____ finished the financial report. (Ha terminado).
Have you ____ to Paris on business? (Estado / Ido - Participio de be).
questions.explanation: Participio de be = been. (Have you been to...?).

questions.question: I would like to ____ you an offer. (Hacer una oferta).
Unfortunately, we must ____ your proposal. (Rechazar).
We reached a ____. Both sides had to give up something. (Acuerdo cediendo/Punto medio).
questions.explanation: Llegar a un punto medio cediendo = compromise.

questions.question: It's a ____ situation. Both companies benefit. (Ganar-ganar).
questions.explanation: Situación donde ambos ganan = win-win situation.

questions.question: Let's ____ on it. (Cerrar el trato dándose la mano).
I ____ send you the documents right now. (Decisión en el momento).
How can I make it ____? (Arreglarlo/Solucionar el error).
Have you ____ made a mistake at work? (Alguna vez).
questions.explanation: Para preguntar por experiencias de vida usamos 'ever' (Have you ever...?).

questions.question: Our company has ____ significantly in Europe. (Crecido - Participio de grow).
I don't think they ____ accept the offer. (Predicción/Opinión).
questions.explanation: Opinión personal sobre el futuro (I don't think...) = will.

questions.question: That price is ____ of the question. It's too high. (Fuera de discusión).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

questions.question: I promise I ____ do it. (Promesa)
We are ____ to open a new store. (Intención)
We sincerely ____. (Nos disculpamos)
The client wants to ____. (Quejarse)
I ____ worked here for two years. (He)
She ____ finished the project. (Ha)
____ you ever managed a team? (¿Has...?)
I'd like to make an ____. (Oferta)
We reached a ____. (Acuerdo cediendo/Punto medio - con C)
It's a ____ situation. (Ganar-ganar - incluye el guion)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta del Review.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

options: We are going to launch the product.
We go to launch the product.
questions.correct_answer: We are going to launch the product.

options: We sincerely apologize for the delay.

questions.correct_answer: We sincerely apologize for the delay.
